Diane's 70th · Eurodam · Thursday, September 2, 2027

Ketchikan: totems, fjords & salmon

The "Salmon Capital of the World," with totem poles, a boardwalk over a salmon stream, and Misty Fjords on the doorstep. It's a morning call, 6:30 am to 1 pm, so tours start early.

Creek Street · Diego Delso, CC BY-SA 4.0
6:30 amArrive, docking downtown
~12:30 pmAll aboard (sails at 1 pm)
WalkableCreek Street is steps from the ship
~58°FExpect rain: Ketchikan gets about 13 ft a year
SalmonSpawning in Ketchikan Creek in late summer

Our top three for Diane

If we only read one page

Morning tours that start 7–8 am fit best. These three are easy and cover Ketchikan's highlights: the fjords, Tlingit culture and a seaplane.

#1 · Best all-round

Misty Fjords & Wilderness Explorer Cruise

$229per person · ~4–4½ hrs

A comfortable boat into Misty Fjords National Monument: sheer granite cliffs, waterfalls and quiet coves.

Why for Diane: all seated, spectacular, and scheduled to fit the 1 pm sailing.

Details & booking ↗
#2 · Culture

Saxman Native Village, Dance & Totem Park

$89per person · ~2 hrs

Tlingit dancers in the Beaver Clan House, a carving center and a totem park.

Why for Diane: short, easy and moving, and it leaves time for Creek Street.

Details & booking ↗
#3 · The splurge

Floatplane Flightseeing & Crab Meal at George Inlet Lodge

$414per person · ~3 hrs

Fly over the wilderness by floatplane, then a Dungeness crab feast at a waterfront lodge.

Why for Diane: a seaplane ride and crab, a birthday-week treat.

Details & booking ↗

Good to know

Before we book

Early start. All aboard is about 12:30 pm, so book tours that start by 8 am. Holland America's own tours are scheduled to fit.

Rain gear. Ketchikan is one of the rainiest towns in the US. Bring a hooded rain jacket.

Weather. Floatplane flights can be cancelled for low clouds; Holland America refunds in full if it cancels.

Prices. Holland America refunds in full if it cancels a tour, and its Best Price Guarantee gives 110% of the difference as onboard credit if you find the identical tour cheaper.
